exactToolArguments.prompt:
Create NEW ORIGINAL ASHVEIL sprite animation art, consistent with the attached OWN Ash Crow idle and attack source sheets. Match this EXACT small black crow model: short stout charcoal beak, compact rounded skull with small dark eyes, layered muted blue-black feather highlights, TWO folded wings, TWO thin scaly feet, short fanlike black tail. No costume, thread, harness, letter tube, magic, glowing eye or colored markings. Do not copy any outside game. Richly textured original pixel-style dark fantasy sprite, same fixed high camera as the reference.

This is SLOW GROUND FORAGING, NOT an attack, walk, hop or flight. A stationary crow pecks invisible food already on the ground then raises its head and swallows. Exactly FOUR ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS = SIXTEEN distinct complete whole-body poses, each isolated in a very spacious transparent cell. Row1 faces DOWN toward the viewer, Row2 faces LEFT, Row3 faces RIGHT, Row4 faces UP away from viewer. Each row stays in its assigned direction for all four columns; no 3/4 head turn away. Read the physical beak axis, not merely feather highlights. Row4 shows the back of head/back/folded wings/tail, face and beak are mostly naturally occluded; do not turn it sideways to reveal an eye.

In EVERY ROW the same four chronological phases occur. Column1: relaxed but attentive upright ready to feed, neck slightly tucked. Column2: neck bends FORWARD AND DOWN, body gently tilts forward over its planted feet, beak aims diagonally down toward empty ground. Column3: lowest contact pose, beak tip reaches the empty ground immediately IN FRONT of the feet along that row facing, both wings STILL FOLDED; rump/tail rise slightly as counterweight. Column4: head rises halfway then near-upright slow swallow/recovery, beak closed; it should flow back into column1. NO enormous attacking lunge or violent recoil. All four poses must be newly drawn distinct anatomically correct poses with the same skull/body/foot proportions. Head moves substantially lower, body stays grounded, not translated forward across the cell.

TWO feet only, coherent claws, weight rests on feet with slight ankle bend. Prefer both planted feet readable in front and side views, although far foot can be naturally partly occluded. Do NOT add feet under wings or draw a third leg. Ground projection of foot pair is stable within each row, not beak tip as anchor. In rear/down-bending view do not confuse tail bottom with actual foot contact. Keep wings fully tucked and match tail/head size to source. Row1 beak lowers toward screen bottom, row2 toward screen left, row3 toward screen right, row4 toward screen top and is naturally hidden by the rounded back.

CRITICAL SPACING: each complete bird occupies at most 60 percent of its cell width and60 percent height. Huge true alpha-zero transparent gutters between every wing/tail/beak/claw and neighbouring cell; no overlap or clipping. Every bird is a closed intact isolated body. Sheet contains ONLY sixteen crows, no words, labels, grid, checkerboard, background, cast shadow, ground disc, dirt, grass, water, food, carcass, victim, blood, bones, detached feathers, glow, light flare or motion trail. No objects in beak. Lighting stays subtle blue-grey on dark feathers, no baked spotlight. Aim at a natural repeatable slow 1.8second four-phase feeding cycle at16worldpx; high source detail but very clear low-resolution silhouette. Transparent PNG.
